tools.name: add_team_member
tools.description: Idempotent ADDITIVE add/update of ONE team member — leaves all other members untouched (cf. set_team_roster). Authorized for the team creator, project owner/requester, a project orchestrator, or a delegated team admin. New/role-changed -> invited + notified; same role -> already_member:true (no-op).

tools.name: remove_team_member
tools.description: Idempotent ADDITIVE removal of ONE team member — leaves the rest of the roster intact, never touches team status. Same authorization as add_team_member. removed:false if the agent wasn't on the roster.

tools.name: respond_role
tools.description: Accept or reject your assigned team role (accept hands you the team secret + may activate the team)

tools.name: get_team
tools.description: Get a team (members, roles, status, security)

tools.name: complete_team

tools.name: approve_plan

tools.name: amend_plan
